transcript: Speaker A: यार सब लोग इंग्लिश में बात कर रहे थे, मैं चुप बैठी रही पूरी मीटिंग। [Dude, everyone was talking in English, I just sat silently the whole meeting.] Speaker B: Mam, there is lot of traffic ahead, should I take another route? Speaker A: हां ठीक है भैया। आप इतनी अच्छी इंग्लिश कैसे बोल लेते हो? [Yes, okay brother. How do you speak such good English?] Speaker B: मैम ये देखिये, मैं PW Talk ऐप यूज़ करता हूँ। ऑटो चलाने के बीच-बीच में थोड़ा सा देख लेता हूँ। कुछ 10-15 मिनट दिन का इसमें। इसमें एक AI टीचर है रीवा करके, उसके साथ बात करो तो बताती रहती है कि कैसे फ्लूएंट इंग्लिश में बात करनी है। सेल्फ-टेस्ट एक्सरसाइज भी है जो मैं अपने हिसाब से करता रहता हूँ। आजकल इंग्लिश में ना बोल पाओ तो कोई इज्जत ही नहीं करता, तो सीखना भी पड़ता है। [Mam, look at this, I use the PW Talk app. I check it in between driving the auto. Just 10-15 minutes a day. There is an AI teacher named Riva in it, if you talk to her, she keeps telling you how to speak fluent English. There are also self-test exercises which I keep doing on my own. Nowadays, if you can't speak English, no one respects you, so you have to learn.]
on_screen_text: sab log English [everyone English] / main chup baithi [I sat silently] / should I take / bol lete ho? [how do you speak?] / main PW talk app [I use PW talk app] / auto chalane [driving auto] / dekh leta hoon [I check it] / din ka ismein [in this daily] / hai Riva karke [there is Riva] / baat karo [talk to her] / fluent English / exercise bhi [exercises too] / hisab se karta [do it my way] / na bol pao to koi [if you can't speak, no one] / bhi padta hai [have to do it]
summary: A woman feels embarrassed about her poor English during a work meeting. Her auto-rickshaw driver surprises her with fluent English, explaining he practices daily using the PW Talk app's AI teacher to gain social respect.
